method: Three interleaved baseline/current runs, two cycles each; no video/screenshots during pacing measurements. Raw over33 in older files uses 33.34ms; this derived report recomputes strict >33ms from retained raw frames. Inclusive method/trace times must not be added.
cpuQuota: 4 CPUs; 400000/100000; no cgroup quota throttling in the matched repeated cases

uninstrumentedRetention.method: Two independent browser renderer processes: host-only and actual installed product. No method wrappers, page sample arrays, page polling timers, frame capture, clock/RNG replacement, or visibility override. Measurements live only in Node. Raw CDP reads return primitive data by value and release their object group after every read; forced GC precedes each checkpoint. Five continuous minutes with document navigation to fresh content, three further launch/Restore cycles, then two minutes after final cleanup.
